major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Alignment
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press as your primary burst window with as much Astral Power available as possible, line it up with Force of Nature (Keeper of the Grove) or Fury of Elune (Elune's Chosen), and spend aggressively for its full duration; this is the baseline cooldown when Incarnation is not talented.

major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Chosen of Elune
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Replaces Celestial Alignment as the preferred raid burst cooldown for its longer duration and Critical Strike buff; cast instant Starfire to consume Ascendant Fires at the start and spend all your Astral Power across the window, and treat it as a charge cooldown that can be held briefly to line up with mechanics.

major_cooldowns.name: Eclipse
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Treat Eclipse as a damage cooldown: enter it with enough resources to spend all Ascendant Eclipses stacks within your next four GCDs, avoid overcapping to two charges, and pair it with Force of Nature whenever possible (cast Wrath first for Solar, Starfire first for Lunar).

major_cooldowns.name: Force of Nature
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press off cooldown the GCD before entering Eclipse or Celestial Alignment/Incarnation so the treants overlap your burst window; do not hold it if holding would cost a use. Talent-gated to Keeper of the Grove builds.

major_cooldowns.name: Fury of Elune
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press off cooldown or hold slightly to line up with Lunar Eclipse or Incarnation; with Lunation the cooldown is reduced by your casts, so maintain uptime to keep it flowing. Talent-gated to Elune's Chosen builds.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use as a single-target cooldown during your Celestial Alignment/Incarnation window when Astral Power is below 40, ideally with several targets afflicted by Moonfire so free casts can convert to Moonfire; can be held up to 15 seconds via Control of the Dream. Talent-gated.

defensives.name: Barkskin
defensives.usage_rule: Press proactively before predictable raid damage or a tankbuster cleave for a 20% damage reduction; its short cooldown allows frequent use, so do not save it for emergencies that may never come.

defensives.name: Renewal
defensives.usage_rule: Use when your health drops below roughly 50% to instantly restore a large chunk of HP without interrupting your casting. Talent-gated to builds that take Renewal.

defensives.name: Survival Instincts
defensives.usage_rule: Reserve for the heaviest spike damage events for its strong damage reduction; pair it with Barkskin on lethal hits when one defensive is not enough.

rules.description: Open with DoTs, then burst window
rules.action: Pre-cast Wrath into the pull, apply Moonfire and Sunfire, then enter your Eclipse and fire Celestial Alignment or Incarnation with Force of Nature or Fury of Elune so every burst cooldown overlaps from the first window.

rules.description: Overlap Eclipse with Force of Nature
rules.action: Time your Eclipse entry to coincide with Force of Nature (Keeper of the Grove) so the treants are active during the buffed window; cast Force of Nature on the GCD just before pressing Eclipse.

rules.description: Sync Celestial Alignment with treants or Elune
rules.action: Always pair Celestial Alignment or Incarnation: Chosen of Elune with Force of Nature (Keeper of the Grove) or Fury of Elune (Elune's Chosen); pressing the major cooldown without its companion is a significant damage loss.

rules.description: Always be casting; never sit idle
rules.action: Bank Astral Power while standing still and dump it with instant Starsurge or Starfall during movement so you never waste a GCD; idle time is the single largest damage loss for the spec.
Press Eclipse before it reaches two stored charges, entering with enough Astral Power to spend all Ascendant Eclipses stacks within four GCDs; sitting on capped charges wastes cooldown uptime.
Keep Moonfire and Sunfire applied and refresh them inside the pandemic window; their ticks feed Shooting Stars and are a major portion of your damage, so never let them fall off the primary target.

rules.description: Spread DoTs and shift spenders on AoE
rules.action: Spread Moonfire to all targets while they gather and apply Sunfire once stacked, then favor Starfall over Starsurge and enter Lunar Eclipse on three or more targets to maximize cleave.
While inside Celestial Alignment or Incarnation, cast Starfire instead of Wrath as your generator since it is instant during the window, hits harder, and has a higher chance to proc Touch the Cosmos.

source_summary: Balance Druid revolves around chaining Eclipse, a short charge-based damage cooldown, into the major Celestial Alignment or Incarnation: Chosen of Elune burst window and overlapping it with Force of Nature (Keeper of the Grove) or Fury of Elune (Elune's Chosen). Enter every cooldown with enough Astral Power to spend immediately and without overcapping charges, while maintaining Moonfire and Sunfire uptime for Shooting Stars. The defining skill is juggling these cooldowns so they overlap on the same window without losing uses, never sitting idle thanks to instant Astral Power spenders.
